targets.rawSql: SELECT rated_battery_range_km FROM positions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(rated_battery_range_km) FROM positions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND((1 - (SELECT rated_battery_range_km FROM positions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT MAX(rated_battery_range_km) FROM positions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL), 0)) * 100, 1)

SELECT ROUND(((SELECT rated_battery_range_km FROM positions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT MAX(rated_battery_range_km) FROM positions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL), 0)) * 100, 1)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(distance_km)::numeric, 1), 0) FROM daily_mileage WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND distance_km > 0 AND $__timeFilter(date)

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS time, ROUND(MAX(rated_battery_range_km)::numeric) AS rated_range, ROUND(MAX(ideal_battery_range_km)::numeric) AS ideal_range FROM positions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND battery_level >= 95 AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Range at Full Charge Over Time

targets.rawSql: SELECT end_date AS time, ROUND((end_rated_range_km * 100 / NULLIF(end_battery_level, 0))::numeric) AS full_charge_range FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND end_battery_level >= 80 AND end_rated_range_km > 0 AND $__timeFilter(end_date) ORDER BY end_date

WITH monthly_range AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, ROUND(MAX(rated_battery_range_km)::numeric) AS max_range FROM positions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND battery_level >= 95 AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1), trend AS (SELECT REGR_SLOPE(max_range, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM month)) AS slope, REGR_INTERCEPT(max_range, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM month)) AS intercept FROM monthly_range) SELECT mr.month AS time, mr.max_range AS actual, ROUND((t.slope * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM mr.month) + t.intercept)::numeric) AS projected FROM monthly_range mr, trend t UNION ALL SELECT (MAX(mr.month) + (gs.n || ' month')::interval) AS time, NULL AS actual, ROUND((t.slope * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(mr.month) + (gs.n || ' month')::interval) + t.intercept)::numeric) AS projected FROM monthly_range mr, trend t, generate_series(1,12) gs(n) GROUP BY gs.n, t.slope, t.intercept ORDER BY 1

list.name: vehicle_id
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, COALESCE(display_name, vin) AS __text FROM vehicles ORDER BY id
